newsitem.title: CHINA: China says opposes strong-arm trade tactics.
newsitem.headline: China says opposes strong-arm trade tactics.

text.p: China said on Tuesday it had no evidence to support U.S. penalties against its textiles and it opposed the use of strong-arm tactics to settle trade disputes.
"We are opposed to one side imposing its will on another in trade disputes," Foreign Ministry spokesman Cui Tiankai told reporters.
"The United States has not fully consulted with China and has not provided clear supporting evidence," Cui said.

China said on Sunday it would temporarily ban imports of selected U.S. textiles, farm goods, fruits and alcoholic drinks from December 10 in retaliation for U.S. sanctions taken against Chinese textiles.
The United States announced penalties against imports of Chinese textiles in September, accusing China of using shipments through third countries to avoid quota restrictions.
U.S. trade officials said on Monday that Chinese violations of a bilateral textile accord were well documented.
